_comment: agy tool names advertised in the init event of real `agy --output-format stream-json` runs. Snapshot used by the vocabulary-completeness law in tests/test_trace_conservation.py: every name here must be explicitly classified, so a tool cannot default silently to a generic call. `code_search`, `moma_search` and `skill_search` were advertised on 1.1.8 but absent since the 1.1.21 capture (with and without a mounted skill); dropped from agy_contracts.py's classification accordingly (test_classification_is_not_stale forbids keeping stale entries). 1.2.5 advertised the same 57 tools as 1.1.21. This 1.4.7 capture adds three -- `list_plugin_accounts`, `run_workflow` and `search_marketplace` -- and drops none; see tests/fixtures/agy/README.md for why all three are classified generic.
